description: No externally validated treatment-naive first-episode classifier predicts future failure of >=2 adequate treatments across settings.
Most TRD biomarker cohorts do not rigorously verify adherence, serum exposure, metabolism or drug interactions before resistance assignment.
Inflammation and other biomarkers have candidate treatment interactions but lack repeated prospective biomarker-stratified validation sufficient for clinical utility.
No reproducible categorical biological discontinuity separating TRD from other MDD has been established.
Candidate immune, metabolic, circuit, transcriptomic and genetic subgroups require external prospective validation and cross-platform replication.
Need prospective measurement of access, affordability, psychotherapy/neuromodulation availability, clinician pathway and treatment delay to quantify system-created resistance.
Formal holdout requires re-deriving historical framework excluding psychiatric comparators; no alternate frozen artifact exists yet.
